exempt.NciCheck.CheckMain: the nci-check exe: reads an instance file and the service's trusted input and prints NciCheck.Baseline.check (or, with --unrolled, NciCheck.Baseline.checkUnrolled) on them, or with --policy NciCheck.Desc.check (NciCheck.check) on the instance alone, or with --count NciCheck.Count.check on it (with --count --detail NciCheck.Count.checkDetail, the private record's); IO around the audited check, not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DescDifftestMain: the description-sized check's difftest, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.DescDifftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against the Python reference, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.Difftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.BaselineDifftestMain: the provenance check's difftest, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.BaselineDifftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.RecordDifftestMain: the record check's difftest, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.RecordDifftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DescLivenessMain: the description-sized check's liveness test, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.DescLiveness.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.DescFuzzMain: the description-sized check's fuzz run, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.DescFuzz.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.CountDifftestMain: the count mode's difftest, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NciCheck.CountDifftest.main, audited under NciCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NciCheck.ProtocolMain: the inference-only executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of NciCheck.Protocol.protocol, audited under CoreProtocol and NciCheck

NciCheck.BaselineDifftestMain.why: 1,218 declarations with θ, θ's provenance and the service's trusted input (the deployment's registration log in R6's chain, the run's digest and its parameters): 1,200 random, just under half of them broken in one way, 14 pinned on a declaration worked by hand (two accepted, citing the log's first record from the deployment's first run and from its third, one negative per refusal code, theta-not-at-deployment-start citing a record registered mid-deployment, an entry of the output kind θ no longer takes, refused theta-provenance as any unknown kind is, theta-not-registered, and two of a field of another JSON type than the string or null the check compares it with: the cited entry's root a number, refused theta-root, and a record's previous neither its predecessor's digest nor null, refused trusted) and two served windows with θ empty, each accepted on its own registration log, and each one's log with the other's Program, refused run-program, on which NciCheck.Baseline.check gives what scripts/nci_reference.py's check_baseline computes, and, on each one the policy check gives a verdict on, what NciCheck.Baseline.checkUnrolled gives on the case expanded gate by gate

NciCheck.CountDifftestMain.why: 1,687 instances of the count of (c, k)-inference blocks (1,500 random, a quarter of them read across their arrays' rows, 6 on each distinct descriptor of the circuits fixtures, and 7 on a declaration worked by hand: accepted, failing on gates, on fresh bits and on the count, θ empty, the blocks its primitives with a parameter θ at one call site and not the other, and a gate in no block), their blocks every primitive the root reaches with some or all of its composites, about a third malformed in one of the 14 ways NciCheck.Count refuses, on which NciCheck.Count.checkDetail, the private record's whole verdict, gives what scripts/nci_reference.py's check_count_detail computes activation by activation: per block Definition its Boolean gates, fresh bits and blocks, the total, the verdict and the first failure, or the first refusal's code; and NciCheck.Count.check, what the count publishes, gives check_count's: the verdict or the refusal's code, and no other field

NciCheck.DescDifftestMain.why: 4,082 declarations divided into IUs of root nodes (3,000 random, a quarter of them read across their arrays' rows, 24 on each distinct descriptor of the circuits fixtures, 6 on a composite keyed with an input id, which is no input node, 2 on a gate reading a nested scan's carry, one of them past NciCheck.Desc.walkBound's limit, 4 on a scan of no iterations, the 3 whose carry is a value (read or not) refused by NciCheck.Desc.resolvable, 12 on whole members of a batch returning leaves of two arguments they share, each another node's, and 335 whose references name leaves of other widths than their types give them, E_REINTERPRET, which both sides refuse, or are their well-typed neighbours: the shapes on which a draft of the liveness test gave NciCheck mistyped Programs, arrays of up to 2^20 (V8, V16) pairs read whole, by leaf, shifted and as quads and 300 random declarations with one reference moved, then the unrolled difftest's three pinned ones, the third a declaration with a constant gate) on which NciCheck.Desc.check gives what scripts/nci_reference.py's check_desc computes, and, on each one it gives a verdict on, what NciCheck.check gives on the instance expanded gate by gate: the description-sized check against the unrolled one

NciCheck.DescFuzzMain.why: 1,330 descriptor v1 Programs from fixed seeds: the 14 worked by hand; the shared-members family (fuzz/gen/shared.py): the 6 declarations of the desc difftest's shared members (whole members of a batch returning leaves of arguments they share, each another root node's output, which NciCheck.Desc read as its first piece's node's alone before Seg.split) and 263 drawn after them (200 seeds and 63 mutants: two or three shared arguments, each a gate, a call, a batch member or the input itself; two to four members, with a mapped argument or none; their leaves in any order, with the member's own gate; read whole, by a run of members or a run cut inside them, directly or through composites), each with its IU assignments (1 to 12, 1,670 in all); 789 random (600 and 189), 183 of segment copies (150 and 33), 23 chains (20 and 3) and 52 big (40 and 12). On each one past NciCheck.Desc.evaluate's refusals NciCheck.DescFuzz.check decides the statements behind DescAgrees: OperandsResolve on primitive nodes, BodiesOk and ReadsExact, and DescAgrees itself, NciCheck.Desc.evaluate against NciCheck.evaluate on the instance expanded gate by gate, on the line's IU assignments and 4 instances of its own on each worked and seed one, 1 on the rest. About 60 s on one core, 15 s on four; NciCheck.Desc without Seg.split fails it on 122 of them, every one shared, in ReadsExact and DescAgrees

NciCheck.DescLivenessMain.why: 13 descriptions naming 2^22 to 2^52 + 1 scan iterations or batch members, past what NciCheck.Desc walks one by one (NciCheck.Desc.WALK): a scan of pass-through iterations a gate reads and one nothing reads, a batch returning its shared input read whole, by a gate and through a mapped argument, scans swapping their carry an odd and an even number of times, carries leaving through an xs row, and gates reading a carry or part of an xs row; on each one NciCheck.Desc.check gives a verdict, the one it gives on the same description at a small count (the novel reads for a description whose reads grow with it), which NciCheck.check gives on that one expanded gate by gate

NciCheck.RecordDifftestMain.why: 687 execution phases' circuit records with their Programs, registration logs in R6's chain, pins and the count's limits: 600 random (one to four templates, their units laid out by inference entries with the slot digit anywhere among the digits, wires that keep to the reader's slot, cross slots or do either unit by unit, each from an output of the row's bits whose leaves' width divides the reader's or into a closed row, some templates passing a parameter's one-bit leaves on (itself, through a call, a callee inside a callee, a batch member or a scan, some only through its carry or only as its outputs, or handed to a callee that returns none of them), registered reads, a table with its table reads and opening, ingress, the first record registering some of the parameters under the root the run commits or another, row formats of 32-bit leaves of either schema that the run's own record or the first one registers in those leaves and of 16-bit leaves in segment rows on parameters the first one registers, and pins of most templates' Definitions), two in five broken, the 74 ways in turn, each refused at one stage; and 87 shaped ones, the first 26 in the shape of a served class, at two slots and three positions and at four slots and 35: the weights registered at the start of the deployment, none registered, none committed, another root, the opening's root read dropped, the opening's reader another Definition whose verdict is a constant 1, one wire from the next slot, the order given beside the record, and the run's record first in the log; then a pinned reader's layout at two slots and three positions: the key left unwired, the key then listed among the opening's ports (refused reader-roles), another row named the key, the root read in the domain id's row, the domain id in the root's, the two swapped, an opened row left out, the opened rows in another order and another output named the verdict (each refused reader-roles), a pinned reader whose key is its second row and one of one output (each refused reader-layout), and the key among the ports and the two readers under no pin (taken, their openings fresh); then a wire's leaves: the served shape's token a word into a key of 32 one-bit leaves that only gates of its reader read, a closed row, and 32 one-bit leaves into a key of one word (each taken), a template that passes on one bit of each of sixteen 16-bit gates, read as one 16-bit leaf from another slot, the bits passed on by the template itself, by one of no gate, through a call, through a callee inside a callee, through a batch member and through a scan, one of them alone through a scan's carry, the other fifteen alone as a scan's outputs, all to an output no wire reads, and the bits handed to a callee that returns none of them (each refused leaf-widths), the same template with its output gates of its own over those bits (taken, its row closed), an output whose leaves have two widths, into a 32-bit leaf (refused leaf-widths) and into a closed row (taken), an output of 8 bits, which lacks bits of the 16-bit row it fills, into one leaf and into a closed row (each refused leaf-widths), and an output of 31 bits, two words, into a row of two words (refused leaf-widths) and wired into a row of one (refused wires); then the served shape's root handing a unit a row that is not input gates of its own: one input run handed to two rows, a row every unit shares, and a row of computed gates (each refused own-rows); then a text the form reads nothing of: the served shape's record as one that lists its members, which states no wires (refused wires), and the text of no wire and nothing else, which names no Program (refused templates); then a row declared twice: the served shape's record with one declaration more into a row it already declares, a case each pair of a wire, a registered read, a table read, an opening's port and ingress that the shape has a row for, fourteen in all (two wires into one row refused wires, every other pair refused inputs); then a template with an output that has no bit, one that returns no field and one with a field of no bit beside a field of 16, each refused templates; then a template keyed as an input id, bound per run and bound at registration, a composite whose gates are computed: the record of that one template, and the served shape's record with a unit of it more at the Program's root that the record does not list, each refused templates; then a row format: the scan state in 32-bit leaves the run's own record registers, its format right in segment rows and in v2 rows, and a weight the first record registers in 32-bit leaves, its format right (each taken, with the served shape's verdict and count), the same weight with no format (taken, its rows fresh), the scan state's format of another width, the scan state with no format, the scan state registered in 16-bit leaves with a 32-bit format, a format on a value the run's record does not register and a 32-bit format on a weight registered in 16-bit leaves (each refused formats), and a format of another schema, a 16-bit format in v2 rows, a 24-bit format, a format with a key more, a format on the table's parameter, a format on no registered parameter, a 32-bit format on an odd number of leaves and a 32-bit format on a weight read in rows of one 16-bit leaf (each refused inputs). On each, NciCheck.Record.checkDetail gives what scripts/nci_record_reference.py's check_detail computes row by row of every unit (the summary's counts, the verdict and the failure, or the first refusal's code, with its message where it has one), NciCheck.Record.check its check and no other field, NciCheck.Record.kinds its kinds of some rows, NciCheck.Record.exported its exported of the same rows (each one's unit's slot and why the row is θ), NciCheck.RecordCount.checkDetail its count, and the templates NciCheck.Record.front reads have its closed rows; and SPOT's reader reads, from the instance Python builds from its own layout of each template, the wiring it reads from the form's, which refuses the wires exactly where SPOT does

NciCheck.DifftestMain.why: 4,000 random declarations and divisions, the description-sized difftest's 335 on E_REINTERPRET (references naming leaves of other widths than their types give them, which both sides refuse as program, and their well-typed neighbours, expanded gate by gate where the Program decodes), and three pinned ones (θ with an input bound per run, refused theta-not-registered, θ the registered input, accepted, and a declaration with a Const8 gate, which reads nothing, accepted), on which NciCheck.check gives what scripts/nci_reference.py computes from Nci.Complies' definitions: per IU its size and novel reads, the verdict and the first failing IU with its rule, or the first malformation's code

NciCheck.Check.why: the check is code: Lean core and C-Flock's program decoder only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NciCheck.Desc.why: the description-sized check is code, as NciCheck.Check is: Lean core, C-Flock's program decoder and the check's instance format and verdict

NciCheck.Baseline.why: θ's provenance check is code, as NciCheck.Desc is: Lean core, C-Flock's program decoder (with the canonical JSON and SHA-512 it imports) and the policy check it runs first

NciCheck.Count.why: the count of (c, k)-inference blocks is code, as NciCheck.Desc is: Lean core, C-Flock's program decoder, the check's instance format and refusals, and the description-sized check's summaries and θ

NciCheck.RecordText.why: what an execution phase's circuit record's text declares is code, read from the decoded Program and the parsed text alone: Flock's program decoder and template queries, a type's bits read from its structure (Flock.Sigma, which imports the decoder alone) and SPOT's reader of the record's wires; nothing else of NciCheck, so that a package NciCheck requires can hold it, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NciCheck.Record.why: the check of an execution phase's circuit record is code, as NciCheck.Baseline is: θ's provenance check and what it imports, Flock's template queries, SPOT's reader of the record's wires, what the record's text declares (NciCheck.RecordText) and the Definition's closure digest; nothing of NciCheck.Count, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NciCheck.RecordCount.why: the count of (c, k)-inference blocks on a circuit record is code: the record's summary (NciCheck.Record) and each Definition's Boolean gates by the gate table (NciCheck.Count)

NciCheck.Protocol.why: the inference-only policy as a core protocol is code: the policy's check (NciCheck.Baseline) behind the core interface's decoders and outcome, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NciCheck.DefinitionDigest.why: a Definition's digests are code: Lean core, the base package's bytes, canonical JSON and SHA-512 and the circuit format's step bound, nothing of the policy's check, no Mathlib and nothing of Security
